candidates.original_title: Crowd IQ: Measuring the intelligence of crowdsourcing platforms
candidates.description: Aggregating multiple responses through majority vote improves collective IQ performance, with collective IQ increasing with group size showing diminishing returns
candidates.citation_sentence: We conducted a partial replication of Kosinski et al.'s (2012) study to re-examine the hypothesis that the overall task performance would be significantly enhanced by tapping into a wisdom-of-the-crowd effect at the micro-task level.
candidates.notes: The paper labels this a 'partial replication' with deliberate methodological simplifications (focus on group size only, larger base sample, different sampling approach, all 60 test items included). The original study's statistics are not reported in this paper, so all original statistical fields are left blank.
